fusions.name: Gnawing Bite
fusions.desc: Hurls a bite of shadow that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Diseased] for 8 seconds. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Over the Side
fusions.desc: A rush of wings across a cone 4 tiles long that deals 8 damage to everything in it. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Scurrying Tide
fusions.desc: Musters a swarm that fights for 14 seconds, biting an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second. Each kill the swarm makes restores 4 health.

fusions.name: Last Off the Wreck
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, you regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
